If you’re using Amazon OpenSearch Service to direct query data in CloudWatch Logs, we also
recommend the following:
• When searching multiple log groups in one query, use the appropriate syntax. For more
information, see the section called “Multi-log group functions”.
• When using SQL or PPL commands, enclose certain ﬁelds in backticks to successfully query
them. Backticks are needed for ﬁelds with special characters (non-alphabetic and non-numeric).
For example, enclose @message, Operation.Export, and Test::Field in backticks. You
don't need to enclose columns with purely alphabetic names in backticks.
Example query with simple ﬁelds:
SELECT SessionToken, Operation, StartTime  FROM `LogGroup-A`
LIMIT 1000;
Similar query with backticks appended:
SELECT `@SessionToken`, `@Operation`, `@StartTime` FROM `LogGroup-A`
LIMIT 1000;
